create.name: Josephine Sorciere
create.bio:
Josephine Sorciere is an English-born mentor and writer living in Adelaide, South Australia, who works with people at turning points in their lives and with the founders and leaders of new ventures. She calls her approach Signature Frequency: the idea that each person carries an original resonance underneath their choices and relationships, and that life and work run more smoothly once they are lived from it. An earlier strand of her teaching, which she named Portalism, rests on the notion that people can draw on gifts they glimpsed in former lifetimes.

Her main one-to-one offering is the Enigma Initiation, a single long Zoom session of up to two hours in which she reads what lies beneath a client's story and sets out to wake their deeper sense of direction. Through Potent Disruptors she mentors founders and executives, and lately she has turned the same way of seeing towards ventures and land projects under the name Relational Coherence. She runs a small imprint of her own, Ancient Future Publishing, which has brought out two volumes of reflections on 2020 and Wandering Enrichment, a memoir of four months of house-sitting around England told through the Gene Keys.

courses.title: The Enigma Initiation
courses.description: A single private session on Zoom lasting up to two hours. She looks at the patterns a client has outgrown and the abilities they have yet to use, with the aim of switching on what she calls their Signature Frequency.

courses.title: Potent Disruptors
courses.description: Mentoring for founders, executives and others who lead organisations. She works on the inner side of leadership, helping clients steady their vision and act from a clearer sense of who they are.

courses.title: Wandering Enrichment (e-book)
courses.description: Her 2024 memoir of a four-month return to England spent house-sitting, sold directly from her site as a PDF or paperback. She threads ideas from the Gene Keys through the journey.
